text:
Elaine: Dropped a new Figma for a compact rule-ordering gesture in the routing editor. Idea: left-swipe on a rule row reveals a compact drag affordance + inline priority chip. quick thoughts?

Mike: Feels tidy. worry about discoverability for new or infrequent users. can we show a subtle animated cue on first load or a 2s tooltip?

Sophia: Contrast nit: the inline priority chip at 14px is low contrast and borderline AA fail. suggest using a stronger blue (#2563eb) with white text and increased font-weight. also add visible keyboard focus state.

Jun: Reordering must be keyboard-friendly. prototype looks mouse-only. propose adding a move menu or keyboard shortcuts (move up/down) so screenreader users can reorder.

Aria L.: For SR: treat the rule list as a listbox and each row as option. update aria-grabbed while dragging and announce final position: e.g., "Moved rule to position 3 of 8." That confirms changes for AT users.

Design-bot: Figma link: https://figma.redwood/compact-ordering-proto. microcopy question: current hint text says `Press and hold to drag` 12; maybe sounds modal. alternatives?

Elaine: Agree the copy is clunky. Also, what do we do when duplicate priorities occur? current validation: `Conflict 12 duplicate priority` feels terse and blocking.

Jun: Draft copy: `Rule priorities must be unique. Use quick reorder or adjust priority to resolve.` softer and actionable.

Mike: If validation blocks save, prefer non-blocking guidance: inline warning + toast linking to a preview that jumps to the conflicting rules. avoid modal blockers when possible.

Sophia: A11y: preview toggle can't rely on color alone to show active state. add a visible label, visible focus ring, and make disabled drag handles meet 3:1 contrast.

Aria L.: For simulation preview: announce progress to assistive tech: e.g., `Simulating 3 of 12 requests 12 25% complete`. on completion announce a summary: `Simulation complete: 94% routed as expected.`

Elaine: Action items: 1) onboarding hint + ephemeral tooltip (Mike) 2) keyboard reorder + ARIA roles & announcements (Jun + Aria L.) 3) contrast + focus updates (Sophia) 4) validation copy + non-blocking UX + preview jump (Jun + Mike) 5) simulation progress announcements (Aria L.). i'll open tickets and link here.

Mike: sgtm. my OOO Fri, can we aim for next Tue EOD for updated proto?

Elaine: yes, target Tue EOD. assigning Elaine, Sophia, Jun. ping if blocked. :thumbsup: 

Jun: i'll mock the keyboard interactions and paste a tiny pseudocode example:
```
// keyboard reorder sketch
if (e.key === 'M' && row.focused) openMoveMenu();
function moveUp() { swapWithAbove(); announce('Moved to position '+newIndex); }
```

Sophia: i'll push contrast variants and add focus tokens in the Figma file.

Design-bot: Placeholder tickets created: RDW-4312 (onboarding hint), RDW-4313 (keyboard reorder), RDW-4314 (contrast & focus), RDW-4315 (validation UX). will append PR links once available.

Elaine: thanks everyone 12 great catches on SR and copy. we'll review in the next design sync. :)
